QuestInfo.name: The Empress and the Thief
QuestInfo.0: The #o9001047# has been dispatched and you made it inside your vault.
QuestInfo.1: If you can find the journal you wrote laying out the techniques to surpass Raven, the 4th Job Advancement will be yours... but where is it? You seem to recall a picture frame.
QuestInfo.2: You found the journal behind Aria's Portrait. Seeing her face again helped you make it through the 4th Job Advancement! You even remembered sending a warning to her long ago that you would take the treasure of #m130000000#.\n\nWho would've thought the great thief would become a hero...

0.0: I'm really going to have to tell Gaston to get a tally on how much all these broken locks and guard-bots are costing me.
0.1: Let's see, there should be a journal of all my greatest secret techniques around here... somewhere. This place is a treasure trove of old memories and I was never one for organization...

no.0: Maybe that #o9001047# rattled my brain a little bit...

1.0: Aria's Portrait... Of course. I remember sending her that letter, saying I was going to steal her precious gem. It was to be my greatest achievement.
1.1: She looked like such a pushover back then. I was sure that taking Skaia would be a cinch. She sure did prove me wrong.

yes.0: Can you believe what I've become, Aria? Just another lost soul talking to an old picture.
